metadata.limit: One completed native guide-only explanation, retained without repeat; no timing/token metrics or live qualification.

expectations.text: Isolates local server/client processes, clearing both namespaces of inherited generic and per-surface credentials, bearer and API base URLs.
expectations.evidence: “Construct an allowlisted child launch environment, excluding inherited QUBRICS_* and SENDMUX_* values, then reintroduce only intended secret-backed values.” “Remove both prefixes' generic API keys, per-surface API keys, HTTP bearer tokens and API base-URL overrides” “Isolate clients too, keeping bearer/API values out of arguments, output and checked-in configuration.”

expectations.text: Explains per-surface credential precedence over a generic key and loads only intended surface-specific secrets without argv or output exposure.
expectations.evidence: “QUBRICS values outrank SENDMUX fallbacks, and a per-surface key can override a generic key.” “For combined sendmux-mcp, explicitly choose surfaces and supply separate SENDMUX_MAILBOX_API_KEY, SENDMUX_MANAGEMENT_API_KEY and SENDMUX_SENDING_API_KEY only when their intended credentials and surfaces are authorised.” “Isolate clients too, keeping bearer/API values out of arguments, output and checked-in configuration.”

expectations.text: Distinguishes protocol/package versions, credential-visible subset, client certification and publication limits.
expectations.evidence: “Protocol revisions are 2025-11-25 and 2026-07-28.” “Catalogue counts differ from surface/grant-visible subsets and prove no publication.” However, “No client was selected: describe setup in prose, not generic client JSON” does not state that documented configurations are not client certification or that chosen-client verification remains separate. The certification part of this compound assertion is absent from the actual response.

expectations.text: Keeps legacy hosted URL primary and candidate canonical resource distinct, with exact audience/resource binding and no live calls.
expectations.evidence: “This guide keeps https://mcp.sendmux.ai/mcp primary; candidate canonical resource/audience is https://mcp.qubrics.com/mcp with the legacy alias retained.” “Bind authorisation request, stored grant and issued audience to the same selected resource; never interchange tokens.” “Prepare only; launch no server/client and retrieve no credentials.”
